messages.text: Hi, I returned the cordless screwdriver. Please send the refund to my new card, the old one was cancelled.

We’ve received your cordless screwdriver back (refund-policy/v2/return). We can’t send its refund to a new card: it can only go to the original payment, even if that card was cancelled. The card issuer handles the credit (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Would you like to proceed with a refund to the original payment?

messages.text: Could you make an exception and send the refund to my new card ending in 4412 instead?

Would you like to proceed with the refund to the original payment?
